title: Design System: GitHub Agentic Workflows Presentation

display.purpose: Title scenes and closing beliefs only.

body.purpose: Short supporting copy that complements the presenter.

mono.purpose: Commands, file names, workflow source, and machine state only.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Presenter notes and modal overlays escaping the stage plane.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Scene transitions, staged reveals, and diagram progression.

components.name: Presentation Control
components.css: .ds-presentation-control { color: oklch(0.83 0.01 160); background: oklch(0.115 0.008 160); border: 1px solid oklch(0.29 0.015 160); border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.45rem 0.8rem; font: 500 0.8rem 'Mona Sans Variable', sans-serif; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-presentation-control:hover { color: oklch(0.985 0 0); background: oklch(0.19 0.012 160); } .ds-presentation-control:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.72 0.16 158); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Scene Surface
components.description: Contained information surface used only when structure requires it.
components.html:
Guarded outcome

Reviewable result with a scoped write path.
components.css: .ds-scene-surface { color: oklch(0.985 0 0); background: oklch(0.145 0.008 160); border: 1px solid oklch(0.29 0.015 160); border-radius: 1rem; padding: 1.4rem; font-family: 'Mona Sans Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-scene-surface strong { color: oklch(0.73 0.14 250); } .ds-scene-surface p { color: oklch(0.83 0.01 160); margin: 0.5rem 0 0; }

components.name: Workflow Code Panel
components.description: Human-readable workflow source with active-line treatment.
components.html: permissions: read-all\nRead the issue and repository docs.
components.css: .ds-code-panel { color: oklch(0.985 0 0); background: oklch(0.105 0.006 160); border: 1px solid oklch(0.29 0.015 160); border-radius: 1rem; padding: 1.4rem; font: 400 0.95rem/1.55 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-code-panel span { display: block; color: oklch(0.68 0.012 160); padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem; } .ds-code-panel .ds-code-active { color: oklch(0.985 0 0); background: oklch(0.73 0.14 250 / 0.1); border-radius: 0.35rem; }

components.name: Micro-demo Stage
components.description: Captured-safe live demo surface with explicit status.
components.html:
Configurable micro-demo
$ gh aw run maintenance-example

Proposed safe output is ready for review.
components.css: .ds-demo-stage { color: oklch(0.985 0 0); background: oklch(0.105 0.006 160); border: 1px solid oklch(0.73 0.16 305); border-radius: 1rem; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Mona Sans Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-demo-stage header { padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.29 0.015 160); } .ds-demo-stage header span { display: inline-block; width: 0.6rem; height: 0.6rem; border-radius: 50%; background: oklch(0.73 0.16 305); margin-right: 0.5rem; } .ds-demo-stage code { display: block; padding: 2rem 1rem 0.8rem; } .ds-demo-stage p { color: oklch(0.73 0.16 305); padding: 0 1rem 2rem; margin: 0; }

components.name: Source Link
components.description: Quiet factual reference anchored to the bottom of a scene.
components.css: .ds-source-link { color: oklch(0.68 0.012 160); font: 400 0.82rem 'Mona Sans Variable', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-source-link:hover { color: oklch(0.985 0 0); } .ds-source-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.72 0.16 158); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview: A live system whose moving parts become legible one layer at a time. Projector-first contrast, GitHub-native typography, chapter color, and choreographed diagrams explain maintenance problems before agentic responses.
keyCharacteristics: One chapter accent at a time

rules.name: The One-Chapter Rule
rules.body: One chapter accent owns the active scene.

rules.name: The Scale-Over-Weight Rule
rules.body: Headlines gain authority through size and negative space, not heavy weight.

rules.name: The Earned-Depth Rule
rules.body: A surface floats only when it must escape the stage plane.

dos: Do introduce the maintenance failure before the agentic workflow.
Do pair every capability with its control boundary.
Do keep source links attached to factual claims.
donts: Don't turn the experience into a dense documentation walkthrough.
Don't imitate a default Microsoft PowerPoint corporate template.
Don't imply that agentic workflows remove human accountability.
